QUOKKA_EXTRAS.APPS_INTRO: With a personal token, from your emails you can archive a document in Pelican and add a deadline to Kooka. The tokens stay on the Quokka server and are never shown again.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.TOKEN_SAVED: saved — leave empty to keep it
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PELICAN_HOWTO: In Pelican: Family → «From iPhone» → «Create the key for the iPhone», and paste it here (the same key is fine).
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.KOOKA_HOWTO: In Kooka: Family → Integrations → «Create a token» (for example «Quokka»), and paste it here.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PELICAN_NOT_SET: Pelican is not set up on this server (QUOKKA_PELICAN_URL).
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.KOOKA_NOT_SET: Kooka is not set up on this server (QUOKKA_KOOKA_URL).
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.CATEGORIES_INTRO: Incoming emails are sorted into these categories. Choose which to see: the ones turned off disappear from the column, the filters and the rows. The emails stay where they are, and turning a category back on shows them again.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_PELICAN_NOT_LINKED: Pelican is not linked: Settings → Family apps
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_KOOKA_NOT_LINKED: Kooka is not linked: Settings → Family apps
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_UNSUBSCRIBE_NO_WAY: This email doesn't say how to unsubscribe
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_APP_TOKEN: %APP% doesn't accept the token: check it in Settings → Family apps
